On-Demand Course

Pediatric Development Course

Mapping the First Five Years: A Brain-Based Approach to Milestones, Movement & Regulation
Open to all healthcare providers working with children.
Two recorded sessions, on demand
1-hour Zoom call with Dr. Jenna Davis
Certification on completion
$1,095 USD
Enroll

The first five years of life shape the neurological foundation for everything that follows.

This certification is designed for providers who want to understand pediatric development beyond checklists, and begin reading the nervous system in real time.

Because milestones are not just physical achievements. They are neurological communication. And when we understand the sequence, the cues and the patterns, we can support development with greater clarity, confidence and intention.

For providers who want to

  • Expand your understanding of the first five years
  • Improve developmental screening confidence
  • Support oral development within a neurological framework
  • Recognize subtle early cues
  • Create sustainable, individualized care plans
  • Strengthen collaboration with parents, educators and other providers

What you will learn

Not as separate systems, but as one integrated neurological story.

Neurodevelopmental Stages & Brain-Body Organization

  • Sensorimotor, Preoperational, Concrete and Formal stages
  • How children process information at each stage
  • The neurological order of development
  • How sequence impacts long-term efficiency

Oral Development & the Brain

  • Oral motor progression from infancy
  • The connection between tongue posture, vagus nerve and posture
  • How intraoral function influences development
  • Pediatric TMJD considerations
  • Oral function as part of whole-body neurological maturation

Developmental Milestones Reframed

  • Milestones as neurological checkpoints
  • The order and readiness of movement patterns
  • Yellow flags vs red flags
  • Subtle cues that signal compensation
  • When to support, when to modify and when to refer

Tonal Assessment & Brain-Body Strength

  • Neurological connection affecting tone
  • Assessments across infancy through adolescence
  • Understanding low tone, high tone and adaptive strength
  • Improving coordination, stamina and functional capacity

Sensory Processing & Regulation

  • The neurological link between sensory input and milestones
  • Brain balance and adaptability
  • Practical clinic and home strategies
  • Supporting regulation in neurotypical and neurodivergent children

Primitive Reflexes in Development

You will review 10 of the most clinically relevant primitive reflexes in the context of early development.

  • Their role in milestone progression
  • Their impact on posture, oral function, learning and regulation
  • How reflex patterns may signal developmental gaps
  • Age-appropriate integration exercises
  • Modifying strategies across abilities and stages

Play-Based Screening & Care

One of the most unique aspects of this course is its emphasis on play.

  • Kiddo-directed observation strategies
  • How to structure a play-based clinic set-up
  • Sensory kits and developmental tools
  • Flow and care plans for superkids, neurodivergent and all abilities
  • How to make assessment feel natural, not clinical

The outcome

After this certification, you will see development differently. You will recognize compensation earlier, understand oral function within neurological maturation, and design smarter, more playful, brain-based care plans with greater confidence.

You will leave with a new lens, one that sees milestones as communication, tone as brain-body dialogue, play as assessment and regulation as organization.
